dedupe_keys.name: pcc suite a collection of open source programs to analyze and visualize gnss antenna calibration values

description: The Institut für Erdmessung at Leibniz University Hannover publishes PCC-Suite for examining how GNSS antenna calibrations affect estimated geodetic parameters. The September 2026 collection is free under GPL-3.0-or-later. Its launcher and six separately released programs provide phase-centre correction analysis, visualisation, ANTEX conversion and indexing, and RINEX masking and repair. PCC-Explorer propagates calibration differences through least squares to coordinates, receiver clock and troposphere; masks represent obstruction by terrain or structures. These outputs can calibrate positioning-error assumptions in infrastructure monitoring and navigation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the suite. This record preserves separate component links because the launcher archive does not contain all programs. The method isolates calibration differences and omits ambiguity resolution, filter tuning and outlier detection. Coverage can be a station, trajectory or grid, with dates determined by supplied observations. Claimed agreement at two validation stations does not establish universal accuracy. Windows packages were not installed and source code was not executed.
